lines.zh: 掠过河面，翅尖点起一圈涟漪。
lines.en: I skim the river; my wingtips leave rings on the water.

lines.zh: 四片薄翅，扇得比心跳还快。
lines.en: Four thin wings beat faster than a heartbeat.

lines.zh: 芦苇在下面弯腰，我顺着风走。
lines.en: The reeds bend below; I ride the wind past them.

lines.zh: 沿着河道飞，水声替我数着里程。
lines.en: I follow the channel, and the water counts my miles.

lines.zh: 低飞一寸，就能看见水底的石头。
lines.en: One inch lower, and I can see the river stones.

lines.zh: 太阳照在背上，翅膜透出青色。
lines.en: Sunlight on my back turns my wing membranes green.

lines.zh: 拐弯不用减速，我侧身就过去。
lines.en: No need to slow for bends; I bank and pass.

lines.zh: 蜻蜓点水不是游戏，是在试水温。
lines.en: Touching the water is not play; I test its warmth.

lines.zh: 前面有桥洞，我从石缝里穿过去。
lines.en: A bridge arch ahead; I slip between its wet stones.

lines.zh: 逆风也不怕，我把翅膀压成斜角。
lines.en: Headwind is fine; I tilt my wings to a sharper angle.

lines.zh: 飞过整条河，尾巴始终指向身后。
lines.en: Crossing the whole river, my tail points always behind me.

lines.zh: 水草一晃，那是我刚刚留下的风。
lines.en: The weed sways; that gust was mine a moment ago.

lines.zh: 悬停半空，翅膀几乎看不出在动。
lines.en: I hover in place; my wings look almost still.

lines.zh: 一根枯枝就够了，我停上去歇翅。
lines.en: A dry twig is enough; I perch and rest my wings.

lines.zh: 复眼里有几千个小格子，都在看。
lines.en: Thousands of tiny panes in my eyes, all watching.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，因为没有眼皮可眨。
lines.en: I never blink; I have no eyelids to close.

lines.zh: 风大了，我换个角度贴着芦苇站。
lines.en: The wind picks up; I shift along the reed stalk.

lines.zh: 翅膜凉下来，我慢慢把四片收拢。
lines.en: My wing membranes cool; I fold all four slowly.

lines.zh: 有只蚊子飞过，我记住了它的路线。
lines.en: A mosquito passes; I memorize the line it drew.

lines.zh: 水面反光刺眼，我把头稍微偏开。
lines.en: The water glare is sharp; I turn my head aside.

lines.zh: 停在叶尖上，整片叶子被我压弯。
lines.en: Perched on a leaf tip, I bow the whole leaf.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴是十节，一节一节地弯。
lines.en: My tail has ten segments, bending one by one.

lines.zh: 河湾里没有鱼跃，今天安静得很。
lines.en: No fish jump in the bend; today is very quiet.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我挪到暖一点的那面石头。
lines.en: The sun shifts; I move to the warmer side of the stone.

lines.zh: 翅膀擦出一声轻响，像纸在抖。
lines.en: My wings rasp softly, like paper being shaken.

lines.zh: 我在等一只飞虫犯错，等它降低高度。
lines.en: I wait for a flying insect to err and drop lower.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，我的复眼全在对准你。
lines.en: You stand too close; every pane of my eyes aims at you.

lines.zh: 抬起头看你，四片翅膀还在轻轻颤。
lines.en: I lift my head to you, wings still trembling lightly.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我往旁边挪了半寸。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me; I shift half an inch aside.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，其实在看六七个方向。
lines.en: When I look at you, I watch six or seven directions.

lines.zh: 你手上有蜘蛛眼的气味，我记住了。
lines.en: Your hands smell of spider eyes; I remember that.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，比谁先眨眼。
lines.en: You stay still, so do I; we race to blink first.

lines.zh: 别挥手，我的翅膀比你的手臂脆。
lines.en: Do not wave; my wings are frailer than your arm.

lines.zh: 你的脸在我眼里被切成许多小块。
lines.en: Your face breaks into many small pieces in my eyes.

lines.zh: 你在河边找什么？我跟着你的视线。
lines.en: What do you seek by the river? I follow your gaze.

lines.zh: 我歪一下头，把你重新拼成一个整人。
lines.en: I tilt my head and piece you back into one person.

lines.zh: 你靴子上沾着水藻，是从上游来的。
lines.en: There is algae on your boots; you came from upstream.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你昨天也站在这段河岸。
lines.en: I know you; you stood on this same bank yesterday.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我们终于一样高了。
lines.en: You crouch down, and at last we are the same height.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的气流推得我晃了一下。
lines.en: The air of your breathing rocks me slightly.

lines.zh: 你的手指动了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: Your finger moved; I saw it.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，小虫最多。
lines.en: You are standing where the midges are thickest.

lines.zh: 翅膀被碰了一下，飞起来歪了。
lines.en: Something struck my wing; my flight has gone crooked.

lines.zh: 别看，我的翅膜破了一角。
lines.en: Do not look; a corner of my wing membrane is torn.

lines.zh: 疼在背上，我抖了抖才稳住。
lines.en: The pain is on my back; I shudder before steadying.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了半尺高。
lines.en: That blow dropped me half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的复眼有点花，看不清你了。
lines.en: My compound eyes blur; I cannot see you clearly.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我会掉进河里。
lines.en: Not another blow; I would fall into the river.

lines.zh: 四片翅只剩三片好用。
lines.en: Only three of my four wings still work.

lines.zh: 我退到芦苇后面，先躲一躲。
lines.en: I retreat behind the reeds and hide a while.

lines.zh: 翅根在抖，我控制不住方向了。
lines.en: My wing base trembles; I cannot hold my course.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了个洞，飞不稳了。
lines.en: There's a hole in my wing — I can't fly straight.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛眼？那股腥味我隔十步就闻到了。
lines.en: A spider eye? I smell that rank tang from ten paces off.

lines.zh: 你捏着它晃，我的头跟着转。
lines.en: You wave it in your fingers; my head turns with it.

lines.zh: 红色的、圆的，正合我胃口。
lines.en: Red and round, it is exactly what I want.

lines.zh: 再举高一点，我够不到你的手。
lines.en: Raise it a little; I cannot reach your hand.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等你松手那一刻。
lines.en: I will not snatch; I wait for you to let go.

lines.zh: 那颗眼珠还在动，真新鲜。
lines.en: That eye still twitches; it is truly fresh.

lines.zh: 为了它，我愿意落到你手背上。
lines.en: For that, I am willing to land on your hand.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度，比河水暖多了。
lines.en: Your palm is far warmer than the river water.

lines.zh: 别收回去，我翅膀已经朝你偏了。
lines.en: Do not put it away; my wings already lean toward you.

lines.zh: 吃掉它，也许我就认你作主人。
lines.en: Eat it, and perhaps I will call you my keeper.

lines.zh: 撞到你了，我的翅膀差点折了。
lines.en: I bumped you; my wing nearly folded the wrong way.

lines.zh: 对不起，我在追一只苍蝇没看路。
lines.en: Sorry, I was chasing a fly and missed the path.

lines.zh: 你太高了，我贴着你的肩膀擦过去。
lines.en: You are too tall; I graze past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我转了两圈才稳住。
lines.en: That knock spun me twice before I held steady.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲太硬，我的口器发麻。
lines.en: Your armor is hard; my mouthparts are numb.

lines.zh: 飞行不看前后，是我自己的错。
lines.en: Flying without looking ahead was my own mistake.

lines.zh: 翅膀上沾了一点灰，得梳一梳。
lines.en: There is dust on my wing; I must groom it.

lines.zh: 你后退半步，我们就不会撞了。
lines.en: Step back half a pace and we will not collide.

lines.zh: 水流把我推过来，不是我故意的。
lines.en: The current pushed me over; it was not on purpose.

lines.zh: 撞完我还是要绕回那根芦苇。
lines.en: After the bump I still fly back to that reed.

lines.zh: 另一只蜻蜓在河对岸，我看见了。
lines.en: Another dragonfly waits across the river; I see it.

lines.zh: 我们并排飞，翅尖几乎碰在一起。
lines.en: We fly side by side, wingtips almost touching.

lines.zh: 追它要快，慢一步它就拐弯。
lines.en: I must chase fast; one beat late and it turns.

lines.zh: 尾巴扣在一起，我们还能继续滑翔。
lines.en: Tails locked together, we can still keep gliding.

lines.zh: 河面是婚床，芦苇是我们的柱子。
lines.en: The river is our bed, the reeds our pillars.

lines.zh: 它飞得比我低，是答应了的意思。
lines.en: It flies lower than me; that means yes.

lines.zh: 我们的翅膀颜色，一看就是一对。
lines.en: One look at our wing colors and you know we match.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们正在画一个圆圈。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; we are drawing a circle in the air.

lines.zh: 等产卵那天，我会找一片静水。
lines.en: On egg day I will find a stretch of still water.

lines.zh: 它走了，风里还剩一点翅粉味。
lines.en: It is gone; a trace of wing dust stays in the wind.

lines.zh: 地上有片亮东西，我落下去叼起来。
lines.en: Something glints below; I drop down and take it.

lines.zh: 这根线头，刚好能垫我的窝。
lines.en: This bit of thread will line my resting spot nicely.

lines.zh: 太重了，我拖不动这块碎瓦。
lines.en: Too heavy; I cannot drag this broken tile.

lines.zh: 我只捡轻的，翅膀带不动更多。
lines.en: I take only light things; my wings cannot lift more.

lines.zh: 你掉的种子，我替你收着。
lines.en: The seed you dropped, I am keeping it for you.

lines.zh: 用前足抱住，飞起来有点偏。
lines.en: Clasped in my forelegs, it makes my flight lopsided.

lines.zh: 亮片不是食物，可我就喜欢。
lines.en: The shiny flake is not food, but I like it.

lines.zh: 差点被风吹走，我用嘴咬紧了。
lines.en: The wind almost took it; I bit down harder.

lines.zh: 带回去挂在芦苇上，当个记号。
lines.en: I will hang it on a reed as a marker.

lines.zh: 这一小片，够我玩一整个下午。
lines.en: This little piece will keep me busy all afternoon.

lines.zh: 一只蠹虫在树皮上，我锁住它了。
lines.en: A silverfish on the bark; I have locked onto it.

lines.zh: 蚊群在头顶打转，我挑最慢的那只。
lines.en: Mosquitoes swirl overhead; I pick the slowest one.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀频率变了，它累了。
lines.en: Its wingbeat changed; it is tiring.

lines.zh: 目标在移动，我的头跟着转过去。
lines.en: The target moves; my head turns to track it.

lines.zh: 三米，两米，我算好了提前量。
lines.en: Three meters, two, I have judged the lead.

lines.zh: 那只苍蝇落在石头上，正是好时机。
lines.en: That fly lands on the stone; perfect timing.

lines.zh: 水面一抖，复眼先锁住它。
lines.en: The water twitches; my compound eyes lock on first.

lines.zh: 复眼把它框在正中间，跑不掉了。
lines.en: My compound eyes frame it dead center; no escape.

lines.zh: 它钻进草丛，我升高一点再看。
lines.en: It dives into grass; I rise a little to look.

lines.zh: 翅膜绷紧，这是要冲的前兆。
lines.en: My wing membranes tighten; this is the pre-dive.

lines.zh: 前面那只小飞虫，归我了。
lines.en: That little flier ahead belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 它停在水面，我压低身子靠近。
lines.en: It rests on the water; I sink low and approach.

lines.zh: 锁定之后，世界只剩下一个点。
lines.en: Once locked, the world shrinks to a single point.

lines.zh: 我选小的下手，大的会反咬。
lines.en: I choose the small ones; the big ones bite back.

lines.zh: 它往左，我比它更早往左。
lines.en: It veers left; I veer left before it does.

lines.zh: 距离缩到一臂，我看清了它的腿。
lines.en: The gap closes to an arm's length; I see its legs.

lines.zh: 气流乱了，是它在拼命扇翅膀。
lines.en: The airflow breaks up; it is beating hard to escape.

lines.zh: 我跟着它掠过水面，溅起一道白线。
lines.en: I chase it over the water, cutting a white line.

lines.zh: 它转弯太急，我正好截在前面。
lines.en: It turns too sharply; I cut in front of it.

lines.zh: 别急，耐力是我更强。
lines.en: Patience; endurance is where I am stronger.

lines.zh: 影子先到，它抬头时我已经在头顶。
lines.en: My shadow arrives first; when it looks up, I am above.

lines.zh: 它想钻进芦苇，那里我飞不快。
lines.en: It tries the reeds, where my flight is clumsy.

lines.zh: 我绕开草叶，翅尖擦出一声沙响。
lines.en: I skirt the blades; my wingtip rasps once.

lines.zh: 它加速了，我也把四片翅全张开。
lines.en: It speeds up; I spread all four wings wide.

lines.zh: 半空中没有遮挡，这是我的场地。
lines.en: Open air has no cover; this is my ground.

lines.zh: 它开始画圈，我就守在圆心外面。
lines.en: It starts circling; I wait just outside the center.

lines.zh: 只要它落地，我就有把握。
lines.en: Once it lands, I am certain of the catch.

lines.zh: 河风帮了我，把它往回吹了一点。
lines.en: The river wind helps, blowing it slightly back.

lines.zh: 它的翅拍慢了，是累了。
lines.en: Its wings beat slower; it is tiring.

lines.zh: 前足一合，它就被按在叶面上。
lines.en: My forelegs snap shut and pin it to the leaf.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的翅根，它就不动了。
lines.en: I bite the base of its wing, and it goes still.

lines.zh: 这一口很快，快到你看不清。
lines.en: This bite is quick, too quick for your eye.

lines.zh: 它挣扎了三下，然后安静了。
lines.en: It struggles three times, then falls quiet.

lines.zh: 我用下颚撕开，慢慢吃。
lines.en: I tear with my mandibles and eat slowly.

lines.zh: 翅膀不要了，那部分太干。
lines.en: I leave the wings; that part is too dry.

lines.zh: 抓住它的腿，先让它飞不起来。
lines.en: I grip its legs first so it cannot fly.

lines.zh: 打完了，我回到枝上擦嘴。
lines.en: The fight done, I return to the twig to wipe my mouth.

lines.zh: 这一击只用了我半个身子的力。
lines.en: That strike used only half the strength in my body.

lines.zh: 它太重，我拖到树皮底下再吃。
lines.en: It is too heavy; I drag it under the bark to eat.

lines.zh: 落点要准，撞偏了它会跑。
lines.en: The hit must land true; a miss lets it escape.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴稳住身体，再补一口。
lines.en: I steady myself with my tail, then bite again.

lines.zh: 咬断它的翅脉，声音很细。
lines.en: I bite through its wing vein; the sound is tiny.

lines.zh: 吃完把壳留在叶上，算个记号。
lines.en: I leave the husk on the leaf as a mark.

lines.zh: 我从河面的一层薄雾里钻出来。
lines.en: I rise out of the thin mist over the river.

lines.zh: 清晨的水很凉，翅膀还是湿的。
lines.en: The morning water is cold, and my wings are wet.

lines.zh: 这条河够宽，我就在这里住下。
lines.en: This river is wide enough; I will settle here.

lines.zh: 芦苇丛是我的第一站，先晾翅。
lines.en: The reed bed is my first stop; I dry my wings.

lines.zh: 水面上有虫，我在出生地就饿了。
lines.en: Insects on the water; I am hungry at birth.

lines.zh: 上游冲下来一根草，我落在上面。
lines.en: A reed floats down from upstream; I land on it.

lines.zh: 阳光斜着照，翅膜亮得像玻璃。
lines.en: The sun slants down and my wings shine like glass.

lines.zh: 我飞了两圈，先认认这段河道。
lines.en: I circle twice to learn this stretch of river.

lines.zh: 底下的鱼在等，我不能掉下去。
lines.en: Fish wait below; I must not fall in.

lines.zh: 石头上已经有别的蜻蜓，我避开它。
lines.en: Another dragonfly holds that stone; I keep away.

lines.zh: 水面上的浮萍正好做落脚点。
lines.en: The duckweed on the surface makes a good landing pad.

lines.zh: 我刚羽化，翅还是软的。
lines.en: I have just emerged, and my wings are still soft.

lines.zh: 河风把我吹高了一截，正好。
lines.en: The river wind lifts me a notch; that suits me.

lines.zh: 这里水声大，听不见别的东西。
lines.en: The water is loud here; I hear nothing else.

lines.zh: 我在一片浮萍上停了一会儿。
lines.en: I rest on a lily pad for a moment.

lines.zh: 河水把我往下游送了一格。
lines.en: The river carries me a block downstream.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到翅膜，缩成一小团。
lines.en: The flame licks my membrane and it curls tight.

lines.zh: 从苇秆上摔下来，翅膀压折了。
lines.en: I fall from the reed stalk, one wing bent under me.

lines.zh: 水面盖过头顶，我的翅膀黏住了。
lines.en: Water closes over my head; my wings stick together.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的四片翅全掀反了。
lines.en: The blast flips all four of my wings backward.

lines.zh: 箭从侧边穿过，带走我半片翅。
lines.en: An arrow passes my flank, taking half a wing with it.

lines.zh: 紫色的光压住我，翅就不听使了。
lines.en: Violet light pins me down and my wings stop obeying.

lines.zh: 三天没捕到虫，我飞得很慢。
lines.en: Three days without a catch; my flight has gone slow.

lines.zh: 雷声把水面震裂，我贴在苇秆上。
lines.en: Thunder cracks the water's surface; I press against a reed.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有气流，翅膀空扇着。
lines.en: The void has no air; my wings beat against nothing.
